summary.text: Katrina Manetta is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 58, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ron Robinson. A community organizer from Macomb County, she says she is running on affordability for working families.

paragraphs.text: Katrina Manetta graduated from Utica High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Oakland University in 2012, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as community organizer.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Macomb County resident who grew up in the district and still lives there.
Manetta advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In the survey, she listed lowering everyday costs such as housing, utilities, taxes and insurance, accountability, and investment in infrastructure and local businesses as her key messages.
She also named small businesses, worker protections, education and job training among her policy interests.
